stock-item-decompiler.head: 498e9581abf31310e60f6b20d42b6fb5c2e2c8a9
stock-item-decompiler.scope: Stock Item Decompiler item shortcut selected the inventory tool and sent 8131 for a Health Pill and a revolver. Both recipes arrived and the corresponding items were consumed. The client suppressed an early recast for the 10 s timer.

script.source: CompileActivate_Subject and CompileActivate_Deactivate set the typing stance while compiling and restore the standing idle when deactivated.
script.runtime: CraftingSession publishes the linked 968 and exclusive state and updates the avatar's typing posture on session open and close.
script.test: StarterCoderInventoryLifecycleMode verifies linked adds and removals, exclusive on/off and both owner stance updates with stock Compiler activation and deactivation messages. PR584 verifies that the stock Compiler opens and closes. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/584

script.source: WriteCodeActivate_Subject enters typing stance. WriteCodeActivate_Deactivate and WriteCodeActivateTerm restore standing idle when the user is typing.
script.runtime: CraftingSession enters the typing posture at activation and removes it when the session ends, including stream and loadout invalidation.
script.test: StarterCoderInventoryLifecycleMode verifies linked add/remove, exclusive on/off and typing/standing stance transitions. The stock Writer opened and closed in PR584. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/584
